sentences.text: Adobe Photoshop is a raster graphics editor developed and published by Adobe Systems for macOS and Windows .	Windows	Microsoft Windows	Adobe Systems	Adobe Systems	raster graphics editor	raster graphics editor	macOS	macOS	raster graphics	raster graphics
Photoshop was created in 1988 by Thomas and John Knoll .	Thomas	Thomas Knoll	John Knoll	John Knoll

Since then , it has become the de facto industry standard in raster graphics editing , such that the word `` photoshop '' has become a verb as in `` to Photoshop an image , '' `` photoshopping '' and `` photoshop contest '' , though Adobe discourages such use .	de facto	de facto	raster graphics	raster graphics	photoshopping	photoshopping	photoshop contest	photoshop contest

It can edit and compose raster images in multiple layers and supports masks , alpha compositing and several color models including RGB , CMYK , CIELAB , spot color and duotone .	masks	Mask (computing)	alpha compositing	alpha compositing	RGB	RGB color model	CMYK	CMYK color model	CIELAB	CIELAB	spot color	spot color	duotone	duotone
Photoshop has vast support for graphic file formats but also uses its own PSD and PSB file formats which support all the aforementioned features .

In addition to raster graphics , it has limited abilities to edit or render text , vector graphics -LRB- especially through clipping path -RRB- , 3D graphics and video .	raster graphics	raster graphics	vector graphics	vector graphics	clipping path	clipping path	3D graphics	3D graphics	video	video
Photoshop 's feature set can be expanded by Photoshop plug-ins , programs developed and distributed independently of Photoshop that can run inside it and offer new or enhanced features .
Photoshop 's naming scheme was initially based on version numbers .

However , in October 2002 , following the introduction of Creative Suite branding , each new version of Photoshop was designated with `` CS '' plus a number ; e.g. , the eighth major version of Photoshop was Photoshop CS and the ninth major version was Photoshop CS2 .	Creative Suite	Creative Suite
Photoshop CS3 through CS6 were also distributed in two different editions : Standard and Extended .

In June 2013 , with the introduction of Creative Cloud branding , Photoshop 's licensing scheme was changed to that of software as a service rental model and the `` CS '' suffixes were replaced with `` CC '' .	Creative Cloud	Adobe Creative Cloud	software as a service	software as a service

Historically , Photoshop was bundled with additional software such as Adobe ImageReady , Adobe Fireworks , Adobe Bridge , Adobe Device Central and Adobe Camera RAW .	Adobe ImageReady	Adobe ImageReady	Adobe Fireworks	Adobe Fireworks	Adobe Bridge	Adobe Bridge	Adobe Device Central	Adobe Device Central

Alongside Photoshop , Adobe also develops and publishes Photoshop Elements , Photoshop Lightroom , Photoshop Express and Photoshop Touch .	Photoshop Elements	Photoshop Elements	Photoshop Lightroom	Adobe Photoshop Lightroom	Photoshop Express	Photoshop Express	Photoshop Touch	Photoshop Touch
Collectively , they are branded as `` The Adobe Photoshop Family '' .
It is currently a licensed software .
